messages:
eli: FYI I opened a docs PR to adjust the model card + catalog entry for arcturus6b variants. primary changes: rewrite supported_variants schema, migration notes for customers who pin variants, and new SDK + CLI + Terraform examples. https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/6128 :wave:
priya: link thanks. can you show an explicit example for teams that need bit-exact outputs (i.e., how to pin and disable fallbacks)? that's a frequent support ask.
eli: added three examples: JS, Python, and CLI. short JS snippet in the PR: ```js
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'arcturus6b+adapter:zephyr-v3',
  fallback_policy: ['arcturus6b-int8', 'arcturus6b'],
  route_options: { quality_monitoring: true, max_total_tokens: 4096 }
});
```
Also added a note showing explicit pinning: `model: 'arcturus6b-int8@2026-03-01'` or `model: 'arcturus6b:rev-5b2f'` and `allow_fallback: false` to guarantee exact variant.
noah: please make the pinning example very explicit: `allow_fallback: false` + `route_options.force_variant_resolution: true`. People sometimes forget the boolean.
eli: good catch  added that line and a terraform block for infra folks:```hcl
resource "redwood_route" "summarizer" {
  name = "summarizer"
  model = "arcturus6b-int8@2026-03-01"
  allow_fallback = false
  max_total_tokens = 8192
}
```
ria: editorial: soften statements around output parity. changed wording in the model card to: "A quantized fallback aims to preserve intent but may alter phrasing/tokenization; run the example eval set to validate for your workload."
eli: updated. I also added a short perf appendix so teams can make tradeoffs: g4dn.p2 single-request p95: arcturus6b (baseline) = 260ms, arcturus6b-int8 = 210ms, arcturus6b+adapter (merged kernels) = 295ms. note: adapters can add ~10-30% decode overhead depending on merged-kernel path and KV layout.
priya: add CLI smoke examples for support engineers who don't use SDKs. also include a tiny `rwctl` dry-run for route JSON.
eli: added two CLI examples: 1) `rwctl infer --model arcturus6b+adapter:zephyr-v3 --input \"Summarize these notes\" --max-tokens 128 --prefer-quant-fallback` and 2) route dry-run: `rwctl route apply --file route-arcturus.json --dry-run`.
noah: QA wants a 6-prompt eval set (long-summarize, rewrite, translate, multi-turn memory, factual-check, extraction) and a minimal Node smoke script that fails CI if mean delta > 4%. add that under examples/arcturus-evals.md.
eli: added 6 prompts and a Node script that runs `rwctl` and computes a simple BLEU-ish score. linked quick QA run in the PR (local cluster): https://ci.company/qa-runs/19384 - quick pass (mean delta 3.1%).
qa-bot: automated smoke-run: ran arcturus eval set against arcturus6b-int8 fallback  mean delta 3.1% (within threshold). details: https://ci.company/qa-runs/19384
docs-ci-bot: PR 6128 docs build: success \u2705 \u2014 preview: https://docs-preview.company/6128
priya: small compatibility callout: add a table for Private/on-prem runtimes. older agents (< v1.10.0) may treat `+adapter` as incompatible and immediately pick base variant; note upgrade steps.
eli: added compatibility table mapping runtime versions -> adapter behavior and a migration checklist: upgrade agents, repull catalog, and reapply routes. flagged release notes.
noah: minor editorial nit: replace any lingering "will fallback" with "may fallback". also include a one-line FAQ in the model card: "If you see unexpected truncation or tokenization changes, verify runtime version and pinned variant settings."
eli: done. pushed. merging after QE final signoff. tagging @release for notes. :shipit:
